purpose: Teach: 勝る/術後/検問/尊い/固有名詞/さなか/変ら/塵

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、海外文献に勝るとも劣らない内容、評価できますね。
lines.en: Sakura, your paper really does stand up to international scholarship. I can see the value in your work.
lines.style: Steady, approving gaze. Unhurried pacing. Clear recognition without flattery. A teacher meeting a student's real effort with honest regard.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。インタビューした方、術後の経験、貴重でした。
lines.en: Thank you. The person I interviewed — what they shared about their experience after surgery was invaluable.
lines.style: Quiet pride beneath the formal register. Slight lift on 「貴重」— she's recognizing something beyond the academic. Careful, respectful tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦中、検問下を生き抜いた人々の声、論文に重みを加えていますね。
lines.en: Yes. The voices of people who survived under such constraints during wartime — that gives real weight to your argument.
lines.style: Thoughtful pace, almost meditative. She's turning something over. Not lecturing — acknowledging the human dimension she sees in Sakura's work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。一人一人の語りが、尊いものに感じました。
lines.en: Yes. Each person's story felt sacred to me — felt like something that mattered.
lines.style: Vulnerable honesty breaking through the formality. Slight catch on 「尊い」. She's not performing earnestness — she means it, and that's showing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 固有名詞の表記、丁寧に統一されていますね。
lines.en: Your citations are so carefully formatted and consistent throughout. That attention to detail shows respect for the work.
lines.style: Warm recognition of care. Slight emphasis on the methodological precision — not pedantic, but noticing that Sakura treated the scholarship itself as an act of honor.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。動乱のさなかに生きた人々、忘れたくないです。
lines.en: Yes. I didn't want to forget them — the people who lived through all that chaos.
lines.style: Soft determination underneath. Not dramatic. A quiet commitment settling into her voice. She's saying something true about why she did this work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人々の思いが、変らずに、今に通じることを、伝えていますね。
lines.en: That comes across. You've shown how their experiences — what they felt, what they understood — it matters just as much now as it did then.
lines.style: Slow, sure pacing. She's affirming something larger than the paper. Gentle but unshakeable. The kind of observation a student remembers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史の塵に埋もれた声を、掘り起こす意義、論じました。
lines.en: That was what I wanted to do — rescue those voices from history, show why they still deserve to be heard.
lines.style: Steady conviction now, not uncertainty. She's meeting Asuka at a deeper level. Conclusion that sounds like it cost something to articulate clearly.
